public_rationale: 'Starting to realize' needs a visible, growing view that scaling alone will not reach AGI. The 2025 record shows one. In March 2025, 76% of 475 respondents to an AAAI survey said scaling current systems was unlikely to produce AGI. In November 2025 Ilya Sutskever said 100x more scale would not transform everything and that the field was returning to research. At NeurIPS in December 2025, Turing Award winner Rich Sutton gave a keynote arguing that AI 'has lost its way'. Google DeepMind's Oriol Vinyals pushed back, but he called the 'scaling is over' view a 'popular belief'. That itself suggests the view had spread.
limitations: No baseline survey to measure change over time.
The AAAI sample is mostly academic, so it may not reflect views inside frontier labs.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence that in 2025 most researchers and leading figures still held that scaling alone would reach AGI, with no visible shift.
